subject: english
question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the segment which contains a spelling error in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

The renowned chef, known for his innovative cullinary / creations, opened a new restaurant that quickly became / a hotspot for food enthusiasts seeking a unique dining experience.

options.text: creations, opened a new restaurant that quickly became
The renowned chef, known for his innovative cullinary
a hotspot for food enthusiasts seeking a unique dining experience.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the word 'cullinary' is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'culinary'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct form should be used to avoid the spelling error.

Hence, the correct statement is "***The renowned chef, known for his innovative culinary __creations, opened a new restaurant that quickly became a hotspot for food enthusiasts seeking a unique dining experience*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Always double-check the spelling of words, especially those that are less common or might be easily confused with similar-sounding words.
 
• Using correct spelling not only ensures clarity but also maintains the professionalism and credibility of the text.
